ops.old: Chip asks Steven for his chicken skin
ops.new: Crisp salted chicken skin crackling, broken into shards with hot honey

ops.old: Herb butter roast chicken with buttered corn. Steven asks for a knife or fork.
ops.new: Herb butter roast chicken with buttered corn, served whole on a platter

ops.old: Chip orders ale for him and his mate
ops.new: A mug of ale with apple and honey, topped up for two mates

ops.old: Crusty loaf with garlic butter, torn by hand. No utensils in medieval times.
ops.new: Crusty loaf with garlic butter, passed along the long table.

ops.old: A glass of Pepsi, refilled. No utensils, but there was Pepsi.
ops.new: Pepsi over ice in a tall glass, topped up between courses.
